plan.doc_literal_usage: Request.input_stream.__doc__ contains 'Use ``environ["REMOTE_USER"]`` instead.' in its deprecation note.
plan.argument_finding_is_false: The only plausible false-positive argument is that docstrings can contain multiple migration hints, but here both the body text and runtime warning agree that 'stream' is the replacement, while the deprecation block uniquely says REMOTE_USER, so it is an inconsistent documentation typo rather than an alias or passthrough.

classification.error_excerpt: AssertionError: deprecated input_stream should point to stream, not REMOTE_USER
